answer: USD 9,000. At USD 12,000 per 24-hour day, 18 hours is three-quarters of a day, so the amount is USD 12,000 × 18/24 = USD 9,000.

A day for these calculations means 24 hours.

question: What demurrage is payable for 18 hours on demurrage?
source_document: Clause 12 — Demurrage and Despatch: Demurrage shall be payable at USD 12,000 per day, pro rata for any part of a day. Despatch shall be payable at one-half of the demurrage rate for each day saved, pro rata. A day for these calculations means 24 hours.
